scientific_prior_art_vetoes.finding: East Antarctic field validation showed zero of 16 proposed satellite-detected colonization/extinction events were real
Site occupancy in east Antarctic landscape depends on region and slope using 50x50m plots; habitat effects already tested
scientific_prior_art_vetoes.source: Southwell et al 2020 Density dependence forces divergent population growth rates and alters occupancy patterns doi:10.1002/ece3.6010

strict_source_level_gates: Read only official published file endpoints discovered via NASA STAC and AADC metadata; never derive or guess alternative numeric file_id
All redirects must stay within published AADC HTTPS host or explicitly recorded official host; reject login, JS HTML application shell as biological data
Limit to 12MiB input bytes per file; larger files HOLD before download, not truncate/parse as full
Only report HTTP status, content-type, content-length, sha256, ZIP member metadata or text first header, not bird statuses or records yet
No interpreting an island labeled potential habitat as an independently verified usable 3-10m nesting site
No treating lack of breeding in a year as a negative without explicit same-year adequate-survey effort and date
No using a site that was never listed as an independently surveyed absence
No introducing cross-year future outcomes into earlier risk-set feature selection
No linking historical east Antarctic island sites to 2021 Cape Crozier nest IDs (different spatial regions and sampling grains)
